resources.string:
iOS 16.5 in a VM on this phone, with HackiOS by OOSEX GANG (github.com/oosexgang).
TCG only: slow, no GPU.
Flow: Debian chroot → install HackiOS → download iOS 16.5 from Apple + build (~14 GB free needed) → Boot.
Nothing from Apple is shipped here; iOS is fetched at runtime for your own use.
